chapter_title: Concerning these Names: God, Rich One, and Angel; who they are.
chapter_note: The chapter is largely systematic, cosmological definition: a threefold taxonomy (god/rich one/angel) repeated across three moments (archetypes in the Land of Light; emanations engaged in the cosmic contest; households of major Light-beings). The opening Q&A is a later hagiographic frame. One paragraph (¶9) pivots from internal cosmological genealogy into mission-language (“apostolate… hope and confidence”), suggesting a later rhetorical/application expansion within an otherwise core sequence.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic opening (“Once again the enlightener speaks”) and set-up in audience-facing terms (“people pronounce it with their mouths”) mark editorial framing rather than impersonal system teaching.
Disciples’ request and honorific address (“our master”) are standard dialogue frame apparatus.

paragraphs.core_text: There are these three archetypes [in the land of light, and there is no measure to] them!
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution: “The apostle speaks to them:” (later compilation frame; ‘apostle’ is not substrate diction).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core sentence is an impersonal cosmological thesis (three archetypes in the Land of Light, immeasurable); the prefatory speaker-tag is later frame.

paragraphs.core_text: So, the ones who are called 'god', are the gods whom the Father has summoned from himself. He has established them after the likeness of his greatness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic definitional taxonomy within the cosmic system: Father → summoned beings → likeness/degree language; no citation or institutional pointing.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, these who are named 'rich [ ... ]', are the evocations of the first rich gods of the Father; because, when the Father had summoned (the first), they themselves summoned evocations. They called them 'rich'.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure internal emanational mechanics (summoning/evocation chain) defining a rank-name; remains cosmos→cosmos.

paragraphs.core_text: They too, the rich ones, have summoned their evocations. They call them 'angel'. These are the three archetypes who occur in the land of light. There is no measure to apply to them!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the threefold degree-structure (god→rich→angel) in a closed cosmological register; no institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: Once again, listen! Other persons who are named 'god' are the emanations who have come from the Father; the evocations of the Father whom he summoned forth. They came out to the contest and humiliated the Enmity.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second iteration of the threefold taxonomy applied to the temporal/cosmic drama (“contest” with the Enmity). Although rhetorically voiced (“listen”), it remains entirely within mythic-cosmological process.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, the 'rich ones' are the evocations of these first living words. They too, the rich ones, have come and performed and fulfilled the pleasure of the greatness, in the worlds that are above and below.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Degree-language and functional cosmology (emanations fulfilling Greatness’ pleasure across worlds). No external/communal referent introduced.

paragraphs.core_text: On the other hand, the ones who are named the 'angels' are the evocations of the rich ones, who had come from the three living words.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed mission/application expansion: “They have been sent in an embassy and an apostolate to this building… brought them hope and confidence.” The term “apostolate” and the consolatory, audience-tilted rhetoric signal later ecclesial/missionary coloring grafted onto the cosmological definition.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Opens as core taxonomy (angel as evocation-level within the three living words), then pivots to later mission-idiom and soteriological encouragement rather than structural exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, they are called 'god', all the gods who belong to the household of the Great Spirit.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed frame attribution: “Once again the enlightener speaks:” (editorial dialogue apparatus).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core content is a systematic third application (name-category mapped onto a cosmic ‘household’), but prefaced by a later speaker-tag.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, the ones who are called 'angel', are all the angels who belong to the household of the Beloved of the Lights.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the internal triadic mapping across cosmic households; no citation, exhortation, or institutional referent despite the surface ‘application’ connective.

paragraphs.core_text: The ones who are called 'rich', are all the rich ones who belong to the household of the glorious Ambassador.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the third triad (Great Spirit / Beloved of the Lights / Ambassador) in a closed cosmological system; definitional and structural voice.
